Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 193
Host: localhost:8080

{
  "code" : "SPRINT-2",
  "name" : "Sprint Squad 2",
  "description" : "제품 개선 Squad",
  "startDate" : "2026-07-13",
  "endDate" : "2026-12-31",
  "sortOrder" : "2",
  "active" : true
}

HTTP response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 80

{
  "success" : true,
  "code" : "COMMON200",
  "message" : "성공입니다."
}
